SELECT p.pno, p.name, p.addr, p.category, p.type, p.thumbnail, p.hit, p.created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT f.fno) AS f_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_id) AS l_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rno) AS r_count FROM place p LEFT JOIN favorite f ON p.pno = f.pno LEFT JOIN userlike l ON p.pno = l.pno LEFT JOIN review r ON p.pno = r.pno WHERE type IN('명소', '자연관광', '엔터테인먼트')
AND ${column} LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'
GROUP BY p.pno, p.name, p.addr, p.category, p.type, p.thumbnail, p.hit, p.created_at ORDER BY ${selected} DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 16 ROWS ONLY

SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/16.0) FROM place WHERE type IN('명소', '자연관광', '엔터테인먼트')
AND ${column} LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%'

SELECT p.pno, p.thumbnail, p.type, p.name, p.addr, p.parking, p.hours, p.ticket, p.imgs, p.phone, p.hit, p.intro, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createday FROM place p WHERE p.type IN('명소', '자연관광', '엔터테인먼트') AND p.pno = #{pno}
